title: Throughput-safe continuous batcher: adaptive historic-probing KV throttle & GPU slab defrag
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Tune the continuous batching scheduler to safely increase throughput for mixed prompt/response length traffic by introducing an adaptive 'historic-probing' KV throttle and a lightweight GPU slab defragmenter. Goal: reduce token cost and GPU fragmentation without regressing p95 latency for latency-sensitive customers.
acceptance_criteria: No more than 5% regression in p95 latency for the 99th percentile of latency-sensitive routes (measured over 24h mixed workload)
At least 4% improvement in average tokens/sec per-GPU on mixed prompt/response synthetic benchmark (90% conversational mix) vs baseline continuous batcher
Measured GPU free-slab ratio reduced by >= 12% during steady-state compared to baseline (same model/sequence distribution)
System falls back to conservative KV throttle and model-variant routing automatically under sustained SLO pressure (verified in chaos tests)
Shipability: rollout plan, dashboard panel, and opt-out flag documented in Console release notes
progress_updates: 2026-03-10: Kickoff meeting. Agreed to prototype historic-probing sampler (1h window) + slab defrag microjob. Assigned perf harness and trace collection tasks.

2026-03-11: Implemented lightweight KV occupancy sampler in staging. Initial heuristic: compute exponential moving average of per-slot residency and a 1-hour histogram of slot hotness. Hooked into scheduler to propose a KV-throttle score.

2026-03-11: Bench run (mixed synthetic 90/10 prompt/response) vs baseline continuous batcher: +6.1% tokens/sec, p95 latency +1.2% (within target), GPU free-slab ratio -9%. Observed occasional 7% p95 spikes during microburst tails.

2026-03-12: Added conservative decay factor and emergency backoff when p95 drift > 3% for 2 consecutive minutes. Re-ran bench: tokens/sec +5.3%, p95 within 0.8% of baseline, slab ratio -12% steady-state.
2026-03-12: Opened draft PR for slab defrag microjob (non-blocking, runs during low-utilization windows) and a runtime feature flag for operator control. PR: runtime#1729.
2026-03-12: Instrumented additional traces to capture KV eviction counts and origin route tags for better attribution in Grafana panels.
decisions: Use 'historic-probing' approach: maintain a compact 1h heatmap of slot hits and a 10-minute EMA to detect rising occupancy; this avoids reacting to single microbursts.
KV throttle will be expressed as a continuous score [0.0,1.0] applied to admission probability; admission probability = base_admit * (1 - kv_throttle_score).

Slab defragmenter will be opportunistic only: it runs when GPU utilization < 40% for a configurable cooldown window and performs local compaction of free slabs without moving live KV cache entries across GPUs.
Emergency safety: if observed p95 latency delta > 3% for two successive samples (30s sampling), throttle is reduced by 50% immediately and slab defrag suspended until metrics recover.
Prefer runtime-side safe defaults; UI flags in Console for per-customer opt-out and override.
risks: Over-aggressive KV-throttle could increase tail latencies for long-context dialogs if not properly tuned.
Slab defrag can interact poorly with long-lived KV reservations; moving KV across slabs is avoided to reduce complexity but may limit defrag efficacy.
Instrumentation overhead might add measurable CPU overhead on the host; keep heatmap compact and sampling rate low.
Corner cases with mixed-model routing: variants with different KV layouts may need variant-aware heuristics.
tests_run: mixed-conv-synth-90-10-24h: sustained 4h run with production-like interarrival times; measured tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies, KV evictions
microburst-sensitivity: 30m test with sudden 10x short-turn bursts to validate backoff and safety cutover
chaos-kill-gpu: restart a GPU mid-run to ensure slab defrag does not block recovery and admission controls behave correctly
next_steps: Stabilize decay parameters for historic-probing (e.g., 1h heatmap buckets, 10min EMA) based on 24h replay of production traces
Finish PR review and land runtime#1729 behind feature flag; add e2e test that simulates SLO regression and verifies emergency backoff
Create Console dashboard tile summarizing kv_throttle_score, slab_free_ratio, tokens_per_sec per-pool and expose per-customer opt-out
Run a staged rollout to 5% of traffic on Dedicated region eu-west-1 for 72h and collect SLO/bookkeeping metrics
Document recommended operator knobs and add to runbook for incident response
